# AiLovePDF

> Browser-based PDF tools for merging, compressing, splitting, rotating and converting PDF files.

Canonical website: https://www.ailovepdf.site/

## Core tools

- Merge PDF: https://www.ailovepdf.site/merge-pdf/
- Compress PDF: https://www.ailovepdf.site/compress-pdf/
- Split PDF: https://www.ailovepdf.site/split-pdf/
- Rotate PDF: https://www.ailovepdf.site/rotate-pdf/
- JPG to PDF: https://www.ailovepdf.site/jpg-to-pdf/
- PDF to JPG: https://www.ailovepdf.site/pdf-to-jpg/
- Delete PDF Pages: https://www.ailovepdf.site/delete-pdf-pages/
- TXT to PDF: https://www.ailovepdf.site/txt-to-pdf/

## Product positioning

AiLovePDF provides browser-based PDF utilities. The listed PDF-processing tools are designed to process documents client-side in the browser rather than requiring a dedicated PDF-processing backend.

For current tool availability, supported file types, limits and privacy details, use the individual tool pages and the site's Privacy/Terms pages as the authoritative sources.
